answer: A ripple is passed, never bought. Forty quartz ledges open each epoch; each claim locks 75 POA, +30 per extra identity from one root, so ten linked fakes lock 2,100 POA. To earn, the claimant starts a ripple: its proof passes through five strangers, each adding a quartz shard, reaching the ledge in 30 minutes. One operator shepherds two ripples at most, so ten fakes need five hands, fifty passes, ten live answers at once. A broken ripple burns 20 POA. The chain reads the path: ripples sharing one hand collapse into one. Bonds are cheap; fifty strangers in 30 minutes are not.
